services.description: List of SSSD services to enable (e.g., nss, pam, sudo, autofs). Must include at least 'nss' and 'pam' for basic login support.

domains.description: List of identity domains to integrate (LDAP, AD, Kerberos). Each domain defines its own authentication and identity source.

name.description: Unique name for this domain (used in section headers like [domain/example.com]).

id_provider.description: Identity backend: usually same as auth_provider ('ldap', 'ad', 'proxy', or 'ipa').

access_provider.description: Optional access control backend (e.g., 'simple' or 'ldap'). If omitted, default rules apply.

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URIs (space-separated in config; provided here as list for convenience).

ldap_search_base.description: Base DN for LDAP user/group searches (e.g., 'dc=example,dc=com'). Required for LDAP.

tls_cacert.description: Path to CA certificate file for LDAP TLS verification.

ad_domain.description: Active Directory domain name (e.g., 'example.com'). Required for AD integration.

ad_server.description: Preferred AD DC hostname for SSSD to contact.

cache_credentials.description: Whether to cache credentials for offline authentication.

ldap_user_name.description: LDAP attribute used as the username (e.g., 'uid', 'sAMAccountName' for AD).

override_homedir.description: Template string to override home directory (e.g., '/home/%u').

min_id.description: Minimum UID/GID to consider valid (avoids system entries).

fallback_to_localhost.description: Whether to fall back to localhost if remote servers fail (disables DNS lookup for servers if true).

allow_groups.description: List of Unix group names allowed to log in (when using 'simple' access_provider).

deny_groups.description: List of Unix group names explicitly denied login.

services_config.description: Per-service tuning parameters (e.g., for nss, pam). Optional but recommended for production.

name.description: Service name (e.g., 'nss', 'pam'). Must match one of the services in the [sssd] section.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity (0–9). Higher levels increase log detail (e.g., for troubleshooting).

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for backend response before failing.

max_connections.description: Max simultaneous connections to the backend service.

service_specific.description: Raw additional config lines specific to this service (e.g., 'pam_policies = persist').
